title: hellenia chinensis
intro: Hellenia chinensis, commonly known as Hellena or Chinese hellena, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine and has been found to possess various health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hellenia chinensis include anti-inflammatory, anti-bacterial, and anti-oxidative effects, which may help in the treatment of various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
